marketLayer.title: US Big Tech AI CapEx & Semiconductor Dynamics
marketLayer.fact: Major US cloud hyperscalers reported a 35% YoY increase in quarterly capital expenditure focused on AI data center infrastructure, alongside extended lead times for advanced hardware.
marketLayer.inference: Sustained infrastructure spending provides strong revenue visibility for semiconductor leaders and hardware suppliers, though software monetization efficiency remains a key factor for sustained multiple expansion.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Pace of enterprise AI ROI realization and high-bandwidth memory (HBM) supply chain constraints.

marketLayer.title: HK Tech Index Momentum & Southbound Inflows
marketLayer.fact: The Hang Seng Tech Index gained 2.3% driven by major platform e-commerce and SaaS leaders, with net Southbound capital inflows reaching HK$6.8 billion via Stock Connect.
marketLayer.inference: Attractive valuation multiples combined with policy stabilization are encouraging domestic institutional capital to re-allocate into core HK-listed technology assets.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Quarterly earnings delivery against consensus expectations and the broader momentum of mainland retail consumption.

marketLayer.title: US Federal Reserve Policy Expectations & Treasury Yields
marketLayer.fact: Benchmark 10-year US Treasury yields dropped 6 basis points following moderating core PCE inflation data and stabilizing labor market indicators.
marketLayer.inference: Declining risk-free rates ease global valuation pressures on growth equities and improve liquidity conditions across Asian emerging markets.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Potential persistence in service-sector inflation that could delay or alter the anticipated Fed rate-cut trajectory.

marketLayer.title: Global EV Supply Chains & Overseas Expansion
marketLayer.fact: Leading HK-listed Chinese EV manufacturers reported a 40% YoY growth in export deliveries to Southeast Asian and Middle Eastern markets during the latest period.
marketLayer.inference: Geographic market diversification is effectively mitigating regional trade policy risks, enabling cost-competitive scale leaders to maintain volume growth.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Potential expansion of protective tariff regimes in secondary markets and foreign exchange rate volatility.
